diagram_previews.alt: Circle with centre O and nine parallel chords of slope 3/4: the red diameter of length 5 through O and, on each side, gray chords of lengths 1, 2, 3 and a chord of length 4 (the upper one blue). A dashed perpendicular of length 3/2 runs from O to the blue chord with a right-angle mark, and a dashed radius 5/2 joins O to the blue chord's end.
